Harden the repository checkout's transitive MCP client dependency to `@modelcontextprotocol/client` `2.3.0` (`@modelcontextprotocol/core` `2.3.0`) via an `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` override ([#11](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/pull/11)).

- Override `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` to `@modelcontextprotocol/client` `2.3.0` (resolving `@modelcontextprotocol/core` `2.3.0`) in this repository's `package.json` and `package-lock.json`, covering both MCP client advisories:
  - [GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h) / `CVE-2026-104850` (`>=2.0.0 <2.2.0`, fixed in `2.2.0`): OAuth credential disclosure to an authorization server selected by an untrusted MCP server (applications using OAuth remain responsible for `expectedIssuer` and issuer-preserving credential storage).
  - [GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw) / `CVE-2026-111769` (`>=2.0.0 <2.3.0`, fixed in `2.3.0`): HTTP transports forwarding custom request headers across origins on redirects (and forwarding request bodies on `307`/`308` redirects), which matches the `requestInit.headers` transport pattern used by DSH's MCP bridge and still affected `2.2.0`.
- Behavior and scope notes:
  - **Checkout-only dependency hardening (existing user DSH hosts unaffected):** npm applies `overrides` only at the root project and does not ship `package-lock.json` or bundle DSH/MCP packages in the published plugin archive. Installing or updating `dsh-plugin-message-edit` does **not** patch or upgrade `@modelcontextprotocol/client` in an existing user's DSH host installation; DSH host dependencies remain managed by the host environment. No plugin runtime or client code changed.
  - **Cross-origin redirect behavior in `2.3.0`:** `@modelcontextprotocol/client` `2.3.0` rejects cross-origin redirects by default (following same-origin redirects on Node and refusing redirects in browsers). MCP endpoints that rely on cross-origin redirects must be configured with their final destination URL.

在仓库检出环境的 `package.json`（`overrides`）与 `package-lock.json` 中将 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 的传递依赖固定为 `@modelcontextprotocol/client` `2.3.0`（及 `@modelcontextprotocol/core` `2.3.0`），同时覆盖 [GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h)（`CVE-2026-104850`，OAuth 凭据泄露，`2.2.0` 修复）与 [GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw)（`CVE-2026-111769`，HTTP 传输在跨源重定向时转发自定义请求头及 `307`/`308` 请求体，`2.3.0` 修复；`2.3.0` 默认拒绝跨源重定向，Node 下仅跟随同源重定向，依赖跨源重定向的 MCP 服务端需配置最终 URL）。该变更仅加固本仓库的开发/测试检出环境：npm 在将本插件作为依赖安装时会忽略 `overrides`，且发布归档不含 `package-lock.json` 或宿主依赖，因此安装或更新本插件不会修改用户已安装的 DSH 宿主环境（[#11](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/pull/11)）。

Thanks to [@anupamme](https://github.com/anupamme) (Anupam Mediratta) for contributing the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` override to `@modelcontextprotocol/client` and `@modelcontextprotocol/core` `2.3.0` in [#11](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/pull/11).

Validation: 56 automated tests (including 37 internal tree assertions), 4 release-tool tests, 13-file npm package verification, npm 10 and npm 11 lockfile stability checks, an 8-case local `StreamableHTTPClientTransport` redirect verification across `2.2.0` and `2.3.0` (`307`/`308` same-origin and cross-origin custom header/body behavior), and isolated fresh-boot and restart DSH acceptance runs across official `0.2.0-rc.2`, official `0.2.1-rc.2`, and the overridden checkout host with an offline model. The `v1.4.1` source tag and release are available on GitHub; npm publication of `dsh-plugin-message-edit@1.4.1` (and `1.4.0`) is pending manual publish.
